highlights: 修复 1.6.8 代理检测结果未回写的问题：测试当前已保存的代理后，账号列表会更新为已连通、未通过或未测试。 升级后，对之前显示未确认的账号重新点一次“测试连通性”，即可写入实际结果。
先测试新链接再保存时，仅复用 5 分钟内、同账号、同节点及认证、同登录会话的服务端实测结果，避免刚测通过又显示未确认。
更换节点、密码或 Cookie、结果过期时不会继承旧成功；失败结果仍显示未通过，代理连通不等于账号浏览器或生成能力正常。
不同配置的临时测试继续不改已保存路线或账号健康；无检测记录显示“代理未测试”，不再被空记录误标为“代理未确认”。
更新服务后请强制刷新管理页。插件仍为 1.0.2、油猴脚本仍为 1.1.2；当前版本无需重装，旧插件需在每个浏览器个人资料中手动升级。
highlights_en: Fix the 1.6.8 proxy-status regression: testing the currently saved proxy now updates the account-list connectivity result. After upgrading, retest accounts with old unconfirmed records once to persist an actual result.
When saving a newly tested URL, adopt only a server-observed result from the last five minutes for the same account, route, credentials and login session.
Changed routes, passwords or cookies and expired receipts never inherit success. Failed checks stay failed; proxy reachability does not prove browser or generation readiness.
Testing a different unsaved configuration still leaves the saved route and account health unchanged. Empty records display Proxy untested instead of Proxy unconfirmed.
Hard-refresh after updating. Extension remains 1.0.2 and userscript 1.1.2; current versions need no reinstall. Update older extensions manually in every browser profile.
